unit: metres for offsets/lengths; original per-floor WCS mm for from_wcs_mm/to_wcs_mm
method: Each complete left/right rectangular sweep contains its route centreline and is covered by the hole-subtracted slab inset 0.15m minus existing wall/glazing/column projections expanded 0.15m. Binary-search widths are rounded DOWN to 1mm.

runtime_contract.index: segments[segment_id].legs[leg_index] indexes frozen route-network consecutive points
runtime_contract.sample: Interpolate left_m/right_m between adjacent knots by legProgress. Clamp signed offset to [-right_m,+left_m]. Do not interpolate raw windows across their boundaries.
runtime_contract.boundary: Every knot takes min of neighboring windows; endpoints taper to zero over 1.5m. Offset is therefore continuous and does not cut polyline corners.
runtime_contract.disabled: No corridor is supplied for pending/stair segments. particle_enabled remains false; UNVERIFIED markers only.
runtime_contract.invalid_centerline: If centerline_clearance_pass is false, add no lateral offset; do not treat this derived data as authorization for that centreline.
runtime_contract.scope: Projection-clearance guarantee only; no verified human walkability, real tread geometry or installed route is claimed.
